name: – Nacho Sánchez Amor – After § 36 – Am 14
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Türkiye
part_text: 36a. Condemns the Turkish authorities’ use of migration flows as an instrument for exerting geopolitical pressure on the EU and its Member States; considers that such actions constitute a serious breach both of the obligations arising from Türkiye’s candidate status and of the fundamental values ​​of the EU;
